description: permuting training labels destroys any regression edge over a train-mean baseline and leaves no systematic OOS rank IC averaged over repeated shuffles
every fold's train label window ends strictly before its test block, the gap meets purge+embargo, and test blocks are disjoint and ordered
recomputing features from raw data sliced to date<=t exactly matches the pipeline's feature matrix
lagging every feature by one extra day does not materially improve OOS rank IC over the honest pipeline
labels cannot be produced without a full forward window; rows lacking one are NaN, never filled

a naive scaler fit on train+test differs materially from one fit on train-only, and the pipeline's own rolling-window features for train-period dates are unchanged whether or not future rows are appended
no negative prices, no long zero-volume runs, no unflagged >40% daily moves, dates strictly increasing
two fold fits/predicts with the same seed and inputs produce hash-identical OOS predictions
